title: All Doors Closed Indicating Lamp
summary: An indication that the monitored passenger-door system is confirmed closed.
purpose: Allow the driver to distinguish a completed door-closed state from the act of pressing a close button.
observations: Lit when the monitored door system is confirmed closed.
Not a closure confirmation during opening, open or closing states.
Actual trains may use additional door-secured indications or departure checks.
interactions: Observe the lamp before and after requesting door operation.
Compare the lamp status with the door state before considering a movement request.
safetyNotes: A close request alone never proves the doors are closed.
Real departure procedures and required door indications vary by operator and rolling stock.
